rationale.general: General competency recommended for any role

behavioral.statement: Tell me about a specific situation where you applied the competency “{{name}}”. What did you do and what was the result?
behavioral.rationale: Behavioral question: a real experience shows how they applied the competency

situational.statement: For this role, “{{name}}” means: “{{description}}”. Describe step by step how you would handle a real case.
situational.rationale: Situational question based on the criterion description

difficulty.statement: What has been your biggest difficulty related to “{{name}}”, and what did you do to overcome it?
difficulty.rationale: Explores self-criticism and the ability to learn about the competency

hypothetical.statement: Imagine that in your first month you must show “{{name}}” with little time and little information. What would you do first, and why?
hypothetical.rationale: Hypothetical question: shows how they prioritize when applying the competency

quality.statement: How do you check that your work meets the following: “{{description}}”? Give an example.
quality.rationale: Explores the quality standards they apply, based on the criterion description

explain.statement: If you had to explain “{{name}}” to someone new on the team, what would you tell them, and with what example?
explain.rationale: Explaining the competency to someone else shows how well they master it
